platform_mcp_mercado_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_mercado_ads_client_id.description: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercado_ads_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_mercado_ads_client_secret.description: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercado_ads_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mercado_ads_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the advertiser's ADMIN account (Product Ads enabled under Mi perfil > Publicidad) (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /users/me: the authorised Mercado Libre user {id, nickname, site_id}.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /advertising/advertisers?product_id=PADS (Api-Version: 1): Product Ads advertisers the user can access ({advertiser_id, site_id, advertiser_name, account_name}); the currency follows raw.site_id. A 404 'No permissions found for user_id' means Product Ads is not enabled for the user.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /advertising/advertisers/{advertiser_id}/product_ads/campaigns (api-version: 2) with limit/offset and filters[status] (active or paused). `budget` is the campaign's daily budget in currency_id; raw carries strategy and acos_target.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Campaign search with metrics: GET /advertising/advertisers/{advertiser_id}/product_ads/campaigns?date_from&date_to&metrics=clicks,prints,ctr,cost,cpc,acos,units_quantity,total_amount (optionally filters[campaign_ids]); one row per campaign with totals for the range (first 50 campaigns). Dates can reach 90 days back; data refreshes daily at 10:00 GMT-3.
